note: OpenAPI request/response accuracy: OptionalQuery, WithRejection and Cached extractors are documented; Option<Path<T>> types path params; Query/Path structs follow serde from/try_from and Option fields with a custom deserializer are required; Path maps/sequences type each segment; empty query structs no longer emit a fake parameter; response parts (CookieJar, HeaderMap, header arrays, AppendHeaders, TypedHeader, Extension) carry no body; Json<(A, B)> is a JSON array; error tuples document their payload; Box<str>/Cow<str> are text/plain, Cow<[u8]>/[u8; N] octet-stream; NoContent is 204 and Redirect 3XX; unresolved types inside Result are description-only; the Schema check no longer flags foreign paths like serde_json::Value and now checks Path<T>; alias defaults may reference earlier parameters.
